validity.recommendation: none — pipeline is real, properly classified, and operating
validity.researcher_notes: Vector Pipeline (U.S. Portion) is a real, operating interstate gas transmission pipeline from Joliet, Illinois to the Ontario, Michigan area. Enbridge Inc. is the sole current operator and owner (originally a DT Midstream/Enbridge joint venture; Enbridge acquired full ownership). Pipeline carries natural gas from Midwest sources to Chicago-area and Upper Midwest markets. Route geometry in routes repo confirms endpoints and corridor. Verified via Wikipedia and Offshore Technology profiles. No evidence of misclassification, duplication with other rows, or attribution errors.
